# fhir-harness-kinds

The graph kinds fhir-harness owns, one folio-graph-kind/v1 node per file (bean dmx1). Owner, 2026-10-04: no central registry for subgraph types; a harness declares its own in a kinds/ graph. The registry loads these on first use, across every instance, and refuses a kind two files declare.

Part of [FHIR IG Harness](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `fhir-harness-kinds`, holding `kinds`.

_This directory holds no files yet._
